name: Cover Company
description: Uruguayan technology retailer that states it is the official distributor in Uruguay for the brands it represents. Sells phones, accessories, smartwatches, audio and TV, computing, gaming, cameras and drones, and small home appliances. States shipping to all of Uruguay for orders above USD 50 and in-store pickup.
description_es: Comercio de tecnología de Uruguay que indica ser distribuidor oficial en el país de las marcas que representa. Vende celulares, accesorios, smartwatches, audio y TV, computación, gaming, cámaras y drones, y pequeños electrodomésticos. Indica envíos a todo Uruguay para pedidos superiores a USD 50 y retiro en tienda.

ships_to.notes: Homepage states shipping to all of Uruguay; free for orders above USD 50. Costs and times below that not stated.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Buy online and pick up in store; store list linked from the homepage.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

sources.supports: official distributor, nationwide shipping above USD 50, in-store pickup, categories
